title: Sign encoding of a Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The sign encoding of the value of the binary encoding of $f$ at $x$ equals $f$ evaluated at the sign vector corresponding to $x$.
